status_note: Closes the FLOAT-FMT-STRUCT-0001 structural residual of FLOAT-OPINT2FLOAT-SIGN-0001: the oracle's host conversions run bit ladders, not host casts. Directly observed on both sides with same-input/same-output bit patterns: FloatFormat(4)/FloatFormat(8) field initialization incl. jbitimplied; the 64-bit TOP-ALIGNED fractional code convention (extractFractionalCode float.cc:113-119, setFractionalCode float.cc:144-153 with OR packing and no masking of x); setSign identity-when-false (float.cc:158-166); setExponentCode OR pack (float.cc:171-177); getZero/getInfinity/getNaNEncoding 3-setter structure with the quiet-NaN mask created top-aligned 1<<63 (float.cc:181-215); static createFloat incl. ldexp gradual underflow (2^-1074 exact, 2^-1075 ties-to-even flush, 1.5x tie keeps the even 2x) and overflow saturation (float.cc:67-80); static extractExpSig with sentinel out-params proving zero/infinity/NaN early returns never write signif/exp (float.cc:89-109); static roundToNearestEven incl. the uintb wrap-around carry and lowbitpos==64 zero lowbitmask (float.cc:276-288); the convertEncoding subnormal-normalize intermediate state via count_leading_zeros of the top-aligned signif with exp = -bias - lz (float.cc:368-376, address.cc:773); getHostFloat across all five floatclasses incl. the denormalized createFloat path (the pre-port implementation returned denormals scaled by 2^frac_size too large); getEncoding incl. RNE ties, denormalized outputs, and NaN payload canonicalization through getNaNEncoding (the pre-port bit-cast passed payloads through); and the full 36-case FLOAT-OPINT2FLOAT-SIGN-0001 replay proving the structural refactor changed no value behavior. Rugra binds the same host libm ldexp/frexp the oracle uses (float.cc:25-26) so the ladder's saturation semantics are bit-identical; a powi product cannot reproduce ldexp(2^11,-1085)==2^-1074.

observation_schema: One line per case. fields: decimal field dump. x*: res=0x%016llX (top-aligned fraction) or %d (sign/exponent). s*/z*/inf*/nan*/cf*/ge*/i2f*/f2f*: res=0x%016llX (cf* is the f64 bit pattern of the created double). esig*: cls/sgn decimal + signif 0x%016llX + exp decimal (sentinels preserved on early returns). rtne*: up decimal + signif after mutation. lz*: lz decimal + normalized signif + rebased exponent. gh*: cls decimal + f64 bit pattern of the host double. Banner line first; 135 lines total.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: extractExpSig writes sgn/signif/exp through pointers — the zero/infinity/NaN early returns (float.cc:95-97) return BEFORE any write, proven by sentinel out-params surviving; roundToNearestEven mutates signif by reference including uintb wrap-around; getHostFloat writes the floatclass out-param on every path; setFractionalCode/setSign/setExponentCode take x BY VALUE and return the packed word (no in-place mutation, no masking of x — OR only).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: No loops in the ported ladder; all order is statement order. getHostFloat declares sgn then frac (top-aligned extract) then exp, classifies exp==0 (frac==0 ? zero : denormalized) before exp==maxexponent (frac==0 ? infinity : nan) before normalized, then exp -= bias and the jbit room apply to every non-early-return path (normal flag gates only the jbit room). getEncoding: extractExpSig -> zero/infinity/nan encodings -> exp += bias -> exp < -frac_size zero -> exp < 1 denormal branch (RNE at 64-frac_size-exp, signif >> -exp) -> RNE at 64-frac_size-1 with wrap-carry rebalance -> exp >= maxexponent infinity -> jbitimplied <<1 cut -> 3-setter pack. createFloat: >>=1 then (double) then ldexp then sign. extractExpSig: signbit -> x==0.0 -> isinf -> isnan -> negate -> frexp -> ldexp(.,63) -> (uintb) -> <<1 -> e-=1.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No accumulators. precis = 8*sizeof(uintb)-1 = 63 and expchange = exp - precis + 1 are per-call constants in createFloat; the extractExpSig exponent is rebased once (e -= 1) per call; roundToNearestEven's single signif += midbitmask either wraps (caller detects (signif>>63)==0 and sets signif = 1<<63, exp += 1) or does not; lz/exp in the subnormal normalize are per-input with exp = -formin->bias - lz.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No sort; all comparisons are exact integer thresholds copied verbatim: exp == 0, exp == maxexponent, frac == 0 (zero vs denormal / infinity vs nan); exp < -frac_size, exp < 1, exp >= maxexponent, exp != 0 (jbitimplied cut); roundToNearestEven tests (signif & midbitmask) != 0 && ((signif & epsmask) != 0 || odd) with lowbitmask == 0 when lowbitpos == 64.
